description:
Professional lighting and sensor planning

Standard-compliant planning and simulation of artificial light, daylight and sensors in real time. For beginners and professionals in lighting planning. Intuitive operation, simple and fast display of the calculation values.
ADDED

New sport-style luminare list output for all exterior projects.
A switch to show standard false colours for emergency result overview.

CHANGED

CodeMeter 9.10 (security update)
Option to disable the automatic activation of Sport mode.
Updated Hungarian translations.

FIXED

Resolved a bug that caused ReluxDesktop to crash when creating or modifying animations.
Addressed issues with the display of isoline labels in print output and corrected the rendering of vertical isolines.
Resolved memory and GDI resource leaks to enhance overall application stability.
Re-enabled buttons for selecting colors and dimming values.
Fixed an issue where emergency sign geometry would drift from its intended position after saving and reopening projects.
An encoding issue causing Windows-1252 photometric files (e.g., LDTs) with special characters to import as gibberish has been resolved, and these files now display correctly.
Fixed an issue that caused significant slowdowns during the triangulation of measuring surfaces, improving overall runtime performance.
Fixed an issue where the radial running track grid was not displayed correctly.
Addressed a critical issue affecting emergency datasheet data accuracy.
Resolved a bug that had caused minor UGR observer value fluctuations.
Improved the stability of ReluxDesktop by resolving an unexpected crash scenario.
Fixed an issue where the product selector failed to download online product files containing non-ASCII characters in their names.
ASR: "Büros und büroähnliche Arbeitsbereiche/Ablegen, Kopieren" used an already taken requirement ID.
Fixed incorrect cylindrical and semi-cylindrical illuminance values for daylight calculations.
Resolved an issue where luminous flux was incorrectly reported as null in exterior scenes when an evaluation area lacked additional surfaces.
Resolved an issue where the building tree display would unexpectedly jump after modifications were applied to a room.
Resolved an issue where luminaire arrows incorrectly displayed through unrelated luminaires.
